decisions.reason: The lever handle family sits squarely within the firm's core metal handle, finishing and ergonomic knowledge, so early market signals can be interpreted and the line refined in-house rather than withdrawn.

Mitred handles rely on proprietary engineering and finishing competencies, which gives high absorptive fit, though they face some overlap risk with similar lines as the range is consolidated after D's withdrawal.
The multifunctional lever extends the firm's barrier-free and ergonomic expertise in line with its strategic direction, so feedback can be assimilated and applied to improve it.
The award-winning 1289 collection has clear external validation and builds on core design and manufacturing knowledge, making it a flagship worth retaining.
The bronze patina finish leverages proprietary finishing know-how across coordinated product families at low marginal cost, supporting the system offering.
